alt_text: Illustrative line diagram, no numbers. Function starts high two weeks before, drops to its lowest at admission, then rises by discharge but stays below the starting level. A solid teal bracket marks the gain since admission; a dashed orange bracket marks the gap still left.

Bar divided into 100 parts for 2,293 people aged 70+ on US medical wards: 23 lost function before admission and did not regain it, 12 lost it during the stay, 20 lost it before admission but regained it, 45 everyone else. 35 in 100 went home less able. Data over 20 years old.
